tools.name: faf_validate
tools.description: Validate a .faf: structure errors/warnings plus the always-33 score faf-cli gives (Rust→WASM, at the edge).

tools.name: faf_score
tools.description: Score a .faf 0-100 with the always-33 faf-kernel, the same score faf-cli gives (Rust→WASM, at the edge).

tools.name: faf_read
tools.description: Parse a .faf and return its normalized structure (Rust→WASM, at the edge).

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "faf_validate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Validate a .faf and return completeness score + errors/warnings (Rust→WASM, at the edge)." → after: "Validate a .faf: structure errors/warnings plus the always-33 score faf-cli gives (Rust→WASM, at the edge)."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
